entry.vector: 0 px/s of camera travel — there is no in-phone camera in this film. .screen-world holds scale 1 / x 0 / y 0 for the whole scene and .device is never transformed. The scene opens with its chart already running: both spending bars are mid-growth at t=0 (scaleY 0.34 → 1 over 0.00-1.25s and 0.00-1.38s, power3.out), so the cut from frame 14 lands on motion, not on a chart building from zero.

exit.vector: 0 px/s — the layout is static from 15.45s. The last account row lands at 14.36s and the stage glow's answering bloom resolves at 15.45s; the final 0.55s is a locked hold on slide 5. Frame 16 opens on the same still, un-zoomed screen geometry.

camera_target: none. No data-camera-target attribute survives in this scene; nothing zooms.

notes.first_second: Device + the תובנות page held at its deep-dive scroll position at t=0: the clipped tail of the stats grid under the header, the section's own border rule, the צלילה לעומק head, its .period track (30 ימים as a filled navy pill), the carousel showing slide 1 (סקירת הוצאות) and the pagination row — prev arrow, five dots with dot 1 already the teal pill, next arrow. Motion in second one: the red previous-period bar and the green current-period bar growing from 0.00s, the slide title wiping at 0.12s and its subtitle at 0.28s, plus the stage title whip at 0.10s.
notes.last_second: Locked hold. Last element motion is the third account row at 13.92-14.36s; the stage glow's reaction runs 14.40-15.45s and then nothing moves. 15.45-16.00s is a still frame on הוצאות לפי חשבונות.
notes.carousel: Five slides on ONE track in 16s — 3.2s a slide, the tightest pacing in the film. RTL means the next slide sits to the LEFT, so #is-track travels +x by STEP=416px per swipe at 3.05 / 6.10 / 9.15 / 12.20s (0.52s, power2.inOut). The track is the app's own control moving inside a clipped .is-view — it is not a camera. Each pagination dot cross-fades its grey circle out while its teal pill scales 0.25 → 1 on the same beat.
notes.charts_enter_in_motion: Every slide arrives with its content already travelling: the donut starts its sweep at 3.30s and lands 0.27s BEFORE the slide finishes arriving (rotate -58 → 0, scale 0.72 → 1, 1.15s); the store list's first row rises at 6.38s, the first transaction row at 9.43s and the first account row at 12.48s — each ~0.24s ahead of its slide's arrival. Every slide is fully formed for 0.6-0.9s before its swipe leaves, so the pace reads brisk rather than blurred.
notes.screen_fill: .is-scroll carries a static margin-top of -105px — the page's own scroll position, never animated. It parks the clipped tail of the stats grid under the header so the screen reads as one continuous scrolling page: stats tail, the section's border rule, the deep-dive head, the period track, a 456px slide and the pagination row sitting just above the nav. Slides 3 and 4 now carry five rows each (the app's own list limit is ten), so no slide but the accounts slide has dead space — that one is honestly short because the demo user has exactly three linked accounts.
notes.real_data: The donut is the real split of the ₪5,630 period: ביגוד ואביזרים ₪2,140 (38%), מכולת ₪1,410, מסעדות ₪1,180, אלקטרוניקה ₪900 — four slices summing to the period total. The ranked stores and the recent transactions are all names from the real stores collection (FOX - פוקס, GUESS, NIKE, שוק פרייס, בורגר ראנץ, KSP); each Latin-named row is its own LTR island so the bidi algorithm cannot reorder it.
notes.no_gold: Zero --stage-gold in this scene, and the donut deliberately stops at four categories so the warning-gold chart-5 slice never appears — the payoff colour was spent in frame 14.
